subject: Cloud marketplace capability matrix & sourcing questionnaire (AWS/Azure/GCP) - Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Sarah Park <marketplace-procure@bigcorp.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 27 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace sourcing questionnaire and capability matrix request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this call yesterday. As discussed on the procurement team, we need a completed capability matrix and short answers to a few sourcing questions to move Redwood through our AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace vetting. Our Security and Finance teams will also review the attachments.

Could you please provide:
- A capability matrix listing supported marketplace delivery models (SaaS, AMI, private offer) per cloud and any regional restrictions
- SLA commitments (availability, latency SLO targets) and escalation paths for Dedicated/Private deployments
- Billing model summary for marketplace purchases (metering, invoice flow, tax handling)
- Evidence of tenant isolation and data residency controls (high level)

Deadline: EOD Monday (4 business days). If you can send an initial spreadsheet and a short PDF summary we can circulate internally.

Thanks,
Sarah Park
Director, Cloud Marketplace Sourcing
BigCorp Strategic Procurement

--
Attachment: procurement_request_form.docx (stub)

Team — forwarding BigCorp's ask. Deadline EOD Monday. Can we split up sections? Draft plan below:

- Laura: capability matrix (cloud-by-cloud delivery models, regional restrictions, private offer/AMI readiness)
- Vivek: SLAs + escalation paths for Dedicated/Private + inference latency SLO examples
- Neha: Security/data residency/tenant isolation summary + SOC2/Security evidence pointers
- Me: Billing model summary + produce the consolidated spreadsheet and 1-page PDF

I'll prepare the sheet skeleton (columns: cloud, delivery_model, regions_supported, marketplace_process, billing_flow, notes). Please add rows and any attachment stubs you want included.

Quick notes from call: we should avoid committing new SLA numbers; we'll present SLO targets we already measure for Redwood Dedicated and point to fallback model variants. For billing, prioritize marketplace contract flow (private offers) and how we reconcile metering to Redwood invoices.

Reply all with ETA if you need changes.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Marketplace Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace sourcing questionnaire and capability matrix request

Soojin — I've sketched the capability matrix and added a new column for deployment packaging (container image, AMI, managed SaaS connector). Key highlights:

- AWS: SaaS listing (US/EU regions), AMI for private deployments, supports AWS PrivateLink for VPC connectivity; marketplace private offers supported in US/EU.
- Azure: SaaS in global regions, Azure Marketplace private offers supported; ARM template for VM-based private deployment. Some Azure regions require support ticket for private offers (not fully self-serve).
- GCP: SaaS + GCP Marketplace container image; private marketplace purchases require reseller flow in certain regions (we note exceptions per region).

I also added a row for "regional data residency constraints" — we can indicate REDWOOD supports region pinning for Dedicated and on-prem options; for Hosted API we capture region-specific hosting on request (enterprise agreements).

Attached draft files: redwood_marketplace_capability_matrix_v1.xlsx (tabbed by cloud) and a short PDF draft for SLAs. I've left placeholders for exact latency percentiles (Vivek).

Laura
VP, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace sourcing questionnaire and capability matrix request

Adding the SLA language here — I've kept this intentionally non-contractual and tied to our Dedicated commitments.

- Availability target (Dedicated pools): 99.95% monthly for provisioned Dedicated nodes (SLA language available under enterprise contracts).
- Hosted API SLOs (best-effort for marketplace listings): regional 99.9% with automated fallback to alternate region/model when capacity constrained.
- Latency examples: 95th percentile < 220ms for short-chat (max length 256 tokens) on Dedicated N-based instances; for Hosted listings we'll provide sample p95/p99 numbers per model in the matrix (model-dependent).
- Escalation: SOC/Support line (enterprise) -> Platform SRE -> Partner Ops; we will include a named contact once vendor onboarding completes.

I've also included a short note about automatic fallback: when model variant is unavailable, requests are routed to a compatible quantized variant to avoid request failures. That should satisfy availability requirements without overpromising.

Vivek
Senior Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Park <marketplace-procure@bigcorp.com>, Evan Liu <evan.liu@bigcorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 13:46:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Marketplace sourcing questionnaire and capability matrix request

Hi Sarah / Evan — please find attached our capability matrix and a short SLA & billing summary. High level points below. Full attachments: redwood_marketplace_capability_matrix_v1.xlsx, redwood_sla_and_billing_summary.pdf

Summary highlights:
- Delivery models: Redwood supports Managed SaaS listings across AWS/Azure/GCP in all major public regions; private offers (AWS/Azure) and AMI/VM boot images are available for Dedicated/private procurement where required. See matrix for region exceptions.
- Tenant isolation & data residency: Dedicated pools and Private deployments provide physical tenant isolation; Hosted API supports region pinning for enterprise agreements. We are SOC 2 Type II compliant — evidence available via secure share (we will coordinate with your security team).
- SLAs: We present sample SLO targets in the attached PDF (Dedicated: 99.95% availability for provisioned pools; Hosted: target 99.9% regional availability). Latency examples included; contractual SLA language is handled in marketplace private offer terms or enterprise addendum.
- Billing: Marketplace private offers flow through your cloud provider's billing and settlement (metering handled by marketplace). For Dedicated bookings we reconcile usage with Redwood invoices and can support invoice re-bill/contracting depending on the marketplace flow. Tax treatment follows local law and provider rules; our billing ops has templates we can share.

Next steps we propose:
1) Please confirm if BigCorp needs a short redlined private-offer template or a standard listing.
2) Security will likely request SOC2 artifacts — can we have a secure upload link or your vendor portal details?
3) We can schedule a 30-minute deep-dive with Platform SRE (Vivek) to walk SLA and escalation details.

If useful I can also provide a short one-page technical architecture for private offers (VPC connectivity, PrivateLink / Private Endpoint patterns).

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Marketplace Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: redwood_marketplace_capability_matrix_v1.xlsx (stub), redwood_sla_and_billing_summary.pdf (stub)
